headline: You've built something solid. The next stage is the hard part.
subheading: You're not a startup figuring out product-market fit. You've got customers, a team, and a track record. But the growth you had early on has leveled off, and you can feel the gap between where you are and where you want to be.

profiles.title: You've had promising early wins with a new kind of customer, but haven't built a strategy around them yet
profiles.description: A few deals have come in from a different type of buyer, or a new industry. There's clearly something there. But you're still mostly relying on the customers you've always had, and no one has sat down to figure out how to systematically reach more of those new ones.

profiles.title: Your messaging was built for yesterday's customer
profiles.description: Your website, your pitch, your marketing materials, they were all written to reach the customers you used to pursue. But the market has shifted, or you have. The words aren't landing the way they used to, and new prospects aren't connecting the way your existing customers do.

profiles.title: You're not short on ideas. You're short on a clear strategy.
profiles.description: You've got instincts about what should work. You've probably tried a few things. But without a clear picture of your next buyer and a strategy built around them, it keeps feeling like guessing. And you've built too much to leave the next chapter to chance.

profiles.title: You need a senior marketing partner, not another vendor
profiles.description: You don't want someone to manage your socials or tweak your ads in isolation. You want someone who understands your business, can sit alongside your leadership, and help you think through the right moves before you make them.

not_for.headline: Who this isn't for
not_for.description: I work with a small number of clients at a time so the work is done properly. This isn't the right fit for businesses still searching for product-market fit, companies looking for someone to run tactics without a strategy behind them, or anyone not ready to act on what we build together.

cta.headline: Does this sound like where you are?
cta.subheading: Let's talk about what's holding back your growth and what a clear strategy could change.
